original_example.description: Fictional messenger and clerk communicate the same west-bridge closure and east-bridge direction. Candidate expressions contrast directness and politeness. An initial Go! candidate is explicitly rejected for adding unsupported urgency. Different scene conditions mean the pair alone cannot establish stable character voice.
limits: Not an approved translation or evidence of player understanding.
Role traits belong only to the fictional setup, not occupational or regional stereotypes.
